title: Congruences concerning generalized central trinomial coefficients via the constant term method
summary: For any $n\in\mathbb{N}=\{0,1,2,\ldots\}$ and $b,c\in\mathbb{C}$, the $n$-th generalized central trinomial coefficient is defined as the constant term in the Laurent expansion of $(b+x+cx^{-1})^n$. In this paper, utilizing the constant term method and generating functions, we prove several congruences concerning generalized central trinomial coefficients. First, we establish a parametric congruence modulo $p^2$, from which several conjectural congruences of Z.-W. Sun follow as special cases.
